All actual commands and stdout metadata/stderr observations retained through exact gzip readback. Stderr over256KiB is a terminal resource failure, final received chunk retained up to64KiB overshoot, incomplete prefix explicitly marked.

Matching received body prefixes are compared byte-by-byte against the pinned retained source. Their original pin+prefix length/hash represent the complete observed prefix without extra multi-megabyte copies. Differing chunks are retained and fail immediately.

TLS/timeouts/connection reset/HTTP429 and500/502/503/504 retry; metadata/complete byte mismatch and401/404 fail without retry. Upload is single-attempt with read-only state reconciliation on uncertain transport result; no clobber.
SIGTERM and SIGINT stop retries and owned groups under exactPID/start safeguards. Nested-owner cancellation is checked after context teardown, including the child-completion boundary.
No native producer bridge or physics change.50MiB own capture ceiling and512MiB free floor must remain inherited and measured before a new full1us run.

V3 does not delete source. Per-part durable handoff requires public metadata and both complete authenticated/anonymous readbacks before parent may remove the local duplicate. A failed-only part must remain local or be separately durably sealed.
